reason: 该插件的核心用户价值是为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供可视化的用量统计面板：聚合本地会话元数据后展示 Token/会话/活跃天数等概览、7/30 天趋势与年度热力图，并提供 CSV/JSON 导出。该定位可直接从 README 的功能说明与面向 Web 的插件配置（package.json）中得到验证。

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的使用统计插件，用于在本地聚合会话数据并以图表方式展示 Token 趋势、模型分布和活跃热力图，并支持 CSV/JSON 导出。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that aggregates local session usage data into charts for token trends, model distribution, and activity heatmaps, with optional CSV/JSON export.

capabilities: reads local session-related metadata for token usage statistics
displays usage analytics views (totals, trends, heatmaps, model breakdown)
adds a web UI entry in DeepSeek Harness sidebar/settings area
supports CSV/JSON export of usage data

reasons.code: Plugin is described as a usage analytics tool for DeepSeek Harness, listing token totals, trends, heatmaps, and model breakdown.
Plugin is packaged as a web-platform DeepSeek Harness plugin via bundle and client injection configuration.
Privacy note states usage indexes are stored locally at DSH_HOME and include workspace/model/token metadata.
Feature list includes CSV and JSON export of statistics.
